**`200`** — A successful response

- **access_activity_log** `string | null` _requerido_ — A log of IP-based access activity for the customer on Whop, submitted as evidence in the dispute.
- **amount** `number` _requerido_ — The disputed amount in the specified currency, formatted as a decimal.
- **billing_address** `string | null` _requerido_ — The customer's billing address from their payment details, submitted as evidence in the dispute.
- **cancellation_policy_attachment** `object | null` _requerido_ — The cancellation policy document uploaded as dispute evidence. Null if no cancellation policy has been provided.
  - **content_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — Uploaded file MIME type, such as image/jpeg, video/mp4, or audio/mpeg.
  - **filename** `string | null` _requerido_ — The original filename of the uploaded attachment, including its file extension.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Represents a unique identifier that is Base64 obfuscated. It is often used to refetch an object or as key for a cache. The ID type appears in a JSON response as a String; however, it is not intended to be human-readable. When expected as an input type, any string (such as `"VXNlci0xMA=="`) or integer (such as `4`) input value will be accepted as an ID.
  - **url** `string | null` _requerido_ — A pre-optimized URL for rendering this attachment on the client. This should be used for displaying attachments in apps.

## `POST /disputes/{id}/update_evidence`

**Update evidence**

Update a dispute with evidence data to attempt to win the dispute. Required permissions: - `payment:dispute` - `plan:basic:read` - `access_pass:basic:read` - `company:basic:read` - `payment:basic:read` - `member:email:read` - `member:basic:read` - `member:phone:read`

`operationId`: `updateEvidenceDispute` · tags: `Disputes` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier of the dispute to update.

### Request body — `application/json`

- **access_activity_log** `string | null` — An IP access activity log showing the customer used the service.
- **billing_address** `string | null` — The billing address associated with the customer's payment method.
- **cancellation_policy_attachment** `object | null` — A file upload containing the company's cancellation policy document.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The ID of an existing file object.
- **cancellation_policy_disclosure** `string | null` — The company's cancellation policy text to submit as evidence.
- **customer_communication_attachment** `object | null` — A file upload containing evidence of customer communication. Must be a JPEG, PNG, GIF, or PDF.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The ID of an existing file object.
- **customer_email_address** `string | null` — The email address of the customer associated with the disputed payment.
- **customer_name** `string | null` — The full name of the customer associated with the disputed payment.
- **notes** `string | null` — Additional notes or context to submit as part of the dispute evidence.
- **product_description** `string | null` — A description of the product or service that was provided to the customer.
- **refund_policy_attachment** `object | null` — A file upload containing the company's refund policy document.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The ID of an existing file object.
- **refund_policy_disclosure** `string | null` — The company's refund policy text to submit as evidence.
- **refund_refusal_explanation** `string | null` — An explanation of why the refund request was refused.
- **service_date** `string | null` — The date when the product or service was delivered to the customer.
- **uncategorized_attachment** `object | null` — A file upload for evidence that does not fit into the other categories.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The ID of an existing file object.

## `POST /dm_channels`

**Create dm channel**

Create a new DM channel between two or more users, optionally scoped to a specific company. Returns the existing channel if one already exists. Required permissions: - `dms:channel:manage`

`operationId`: `createDmChannel` · tags: `Dm channels` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- **company_id** `string | null` — The unique identifier of the company to scope this DM channel to. When set, the channel is visible only within that company context.
- **custom_name** `string | null` — A custom display name for the DM channel. For example, 'Project Discussion'.
- **notifications_enabled** `boolean | null` — Whether Whop app notifications are enabled for this direct message channel. Webhooks still fire.
- **with_user_ids** `string[]` _requerido_ — The list of user identifiers to include in the DM channel. Each entry can be an email, username, or user ID (e.g. 'user_xxxxx').

## `GET /experiences`

**List experiences**

Returns a paginated list of experiences belonging to a company, with optional filtering by product and app.

`operationId`: `listExperience` · tags: `Experiences` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **after** (`query`) `string`
- **before** (`query`) `string`
- **first** (`query`) `integer`
- **last** (`query`) `integer`
- **company_id** (`query`) `string` _requerido_
- **product_id** (`query`) `string`
- **app_id** (`query`) `string`
- **created_before** (`query`) `string`
- **created_after** (`query`) `string`

### Respuestas

**`200`** — A successful response

- **data** `ExperienceListItem[]` _requerido_ — A list of nodes.
  - `array` de:
    - **app** `object` _requerido_ — The app that powers this experience, defining its interface and behavior.
      - **icon** `object | null` _requerido_ — The icon image for this app, displayed on the app store, product pages, checkout, and as the default icon for experiences using this app.
        - **url** `string | null` _requerido_ — A pre-optimized URL for rendering this attachment on the client. This should be used for displaying attachments in apps.
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the app.
      - **name** `string` _requerido_ — The display name of this app shown on the app store and in experience navigation. Maximum 30 characters.
    - **company** `object` _requerido_ — The company that owns this experience.
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the company.
      - **route** `string` _requerido_ — URL slug for the account's store page, e.g. `pickaxe` in whop.com/pickaxe.
      - **title** `string` _requerido_ — The display name of the company shown to customers.
    - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — The datetime the experience was created. · formato: `date-time`
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the experience.
    - **image** `object | null` _requerido_ — The custom logo image for this experience. Null if no custom logo has been uploaded.
      - **url** `string | null` _requerido_ — A pre-optimized URL for rendering this attachment on the client. This should be used for displaying attachments in apps.
    - **is_public** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether this experience is publicly visible to all users, including those without a membership.
    - **name** `string` _requerido_ — The display name of this experience shown to users in the product navigation. Maximum 255 characters.
    - **order** `string | null` _requerido_ — The sort position of this experience within its section. Lower values appear first. Null if no position has been set.
- **page_info** `PageInfo` _requerido_ — Information to aid in pagination.
  - **end_cursor** `string | null` _requerido_ — When paginating forwards, the cursor to continue.
  - **has_next_page** `boolean` _requerido_ — When paginating forwards, are there more items?
  - **has_previous_page** `boolean` _requerido_ — When paginating backwards, are there more items?
  - **start_cursor** `string | null` _requerido_ — When paginating backwards, the cursor to continue.

## `POST /experiences/{id}/duplicate`

**Duplicate experience**

Duplicates an existing experience. The name will be copied, unless provided. The new experience will be attached to the same products as the original experience. If duplicating a Forum or Chat experience, the new experience will have the same settings as the original experience, e.g. who can post, who can comment, etc. No content, e.g. posts, messages, lessons from within the original experience will be copied. Required permissions: - `experience:create`

## `GET /fee_markups`

**List fee markups**

Returns a paginated list of fee markups configured for a company. If the company is a platform account, returns the platform default markups. Required permissions: - `company:update_child_fees`

`operationId`: `listFeeMarkup` · tags: `Fee markups` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **after** (`query`) `string`
- **before** (`query`) `string`
- **first** (`query`) `integer`
- **last** (`query`) `integer`
- **company_id** (`query`) `string` _requerido_

### Respuestas

**`200`** — A successful response

- **data** `FeeMarkupListItem[]` _requerido_ — A list of nodes.
  - `array` de:
    - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — The datetime the fee markup was created. · formato: `date-time`
    - **fee_type** `FeeMarkupTypes` _requerido_ — The category of fee this markup applies to. · valores: `crypto_withdrawal_markup`, `rtp_withdrawal_markup`, `next_day_bank_withdrawal_markup`, `bank_wire_withdrawal_markup`, `digital_wallet_withdrawal_markup`
    - **fixed_fee_usd** `number | null` _requerido_ — A flat fee charged per transaction, in USD. Ranges from 0 to 50. Null if no fixed fee is configured.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the fee markup.
    - **notes** `string | null` _requerido_ — Internal notes about this fee markup, visible only to administrators. Null if no notes have been added.
    - **percentage_fee** `number | null` _requerido_ — A percentage-based fee charged per transaction. Ranges from 0 to 25. Null if no percentage fee is configured.
    - **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — The datetime the fee markup was last updated. · formato: `date-time`
- **page_info** `PageInfo` _requerido_ — Information to aid in pagination.
  - **end_cursor** `string | null` _requerido_ — When paginating forwards, the cursor to continue.
  - **has_next_page** `boolean` _requerido_ — When paginating forwards, are there more items?
  - **has_previous_page** `boolean` _requerido_ — When paginating backwards, are there more items?
  - **start_cursor** `string | null` _requerido_ — When paginating backwards, the cursor to continue.

## `POST /fee_markups`

**Create fee markup**

Create or update a fee markup for a company. If a markup for the specified fee type already exists, it will be updated with the new values. Required permissions: - `company:update_child_fees`

`operationId`: `createFeeMarkup` · tags: `Fee markups` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- **company_id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier of the company to create or update the fee markup for.
- **fee_type** `FeeMarkupTypes` _requerido_ — The type of fee this markup applies to, such as processing or platform fees. · valores: `crypto_withdrawal_markup`, `rtp_withdrawal_markup`, `next_day_bank_withdrawal_markup`, `bank_wire_withdrawal_markup`, `digital_wallet_withdrawal_markup`
- **fixed_fee_usd** `number | null` — The fixed fee amount in USD to charge per transaction. Must be between 0 and 50.
- **metadata** `object | null` — Custom key-value metadata to attach to this fee markup.
- **notes** `string | null` — Internal notes about this fee markup for record-keeping purposes.
- **percentage_fee** `number | null` — The percentage fee to charge per transaction. Must be between 0 and 25.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — A successful response

- **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — The datetime the fee markup was created. · formato: `date-time`
- **fee_type** `FeeMarkupTypes` _requerido_ — The category of fee this markup applies to. · valores: `crypto_withdrawal_markup`, `rtp_withdrawal_markup`, `next_day_bank_withdrawal_markup`, `bank_wire_withdrawal_markup`, `digital_wallet_withdrawal_markup`
- **fixed_fee_usd** `number | null` _requerido_ — A flat fee charged per transaction, in USD. Ranges from 0 to 50. Null if no fixed fee is configured.
- **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the fee markup.
- **notes** `string | null` _requerido_ — Internal notes about this fee markup, visible only to administrators. Null if no notes have been added.
- **percentage_fee** `number | null` _requerido_ — A percentage-based fee charged per transaction. Ranges from 0 to 25. Null if no percentage fee is configured.
- **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — The datetime the fee markup was last updated. · formato: `date-time`

## `POST /files`

**Create file**

Create a new file record and receive a presigned URL for uploading content to S3.

`operationId`: `createFile` · tags: `Files` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- **filename** `string` _requerido_ — The name of the file including its extension (e.g., "photo.png" or "document.pdf").
- **visibility** `FileVisibility | null` — Controls whether the file is publicly accessible via CDN or requires authentication. Defaults to private.
  - _uno de:_
    - **FileVisibility**
      - Controls whether an uploaded file is publicly accessible or requires authentication to access.
    - **null**

### Respuestas

**`200`** — A successful response

- **content_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — The MIME type of the uploaded file (e.g., image/jpeg, video/mp4, audio/mpeg).
- **filename** `string | null` _requerido_ — The original filename of the uploaded file, including its file extension.
- **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the file.
- **size** `string | null` _requerido_ — The file size in bytes. Null if the file has not finished uploading.
- **upload_headers** `object | null` _requerido_ — Headers to include in the upload request. Only present in the response from the create mutation.

- **upload_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — The presigned URL to upload the file contents to. Only present in the response from the create mutation.
- **url** `string | null` _requerido_ — The URL for accessing the file. For public files, this is a permanent CDN URL. For private files, this is a signed URL that expires. Null if the file has not finished uploading.
- **visibility** `FileVisibility` _requerido_ — Whether the file is publicly accessible or requires authentication. · valores: `public`, `private`

- **parent_id** (`query`) `string`

## `POST /forum_posts`

**Create forum post**

Create a new forum post or comment within an experience. Supports text content, attachments, polls, paywalling, and pinning. Pass experience_id 'public' with a company_id to post to a company's public forum. Required permissions: - `forum:post:create`

`operationId`: `createForumPost` · tags: `Forum posts` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- **attachments** `array | null` — A list of file attachments to include with the post, such as images or videos.
  - `array` de:
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The ID of an existing file object.
- **company_id** `string | null` — The unique identifier of the company whose public forum to post in. Required when experience_id is 'public'. For example, 'biz_xxxxx'.
- **content** `string | null` — The main body of the post in Markdown format. For example, 'Check out this **update**'. Hidden if the post is paywalled and the viewer has not purchased access.
- **experience_id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier of the experience to create this post in. For example, 'exp_xxxxx'. Pass 'public' along with company_id to automatically use the company's public forum.
- **is_mention** `boolean | null` — Whether to send this post as a mention notification to all users in the experience who have mentions enabled.
- **parent_id** `string | null` — The unique identifier of the parent post to comment on. Omit this field to create a top-level post.
- **paywall_amount** `number | null` — The price to unlock this post in the specified paywall currency. For example, 5.00 for $5.00. When set, users must purchase access to view the post content.
- **paywall_currency** `Currencies | null` — The currency for the paywall price on this post. When set along with paywall_amount, users must purchase access to view the post content.
  - _uno de:_
    - **Currencies**
      - The available currencies on the platform
    - **null**
- **pinned** `boolean | null` — Whether this post should be pinned to the top of the forum.
- **poll** `object | null` — A poll to attach to this post, allowing members to vote on options.
  - **options** `object[]` _requerido_ — The options for the poll. Must have sequential IDs starting from 1
    - `array` de:
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Sequential ID for the poll option (starting from '1')
      - **text** `string` _requerido_ — The text of the poll option
- **rich_content** `string | null` — The rich content of the post in Tiptap JSON format. When provided, takes priority over the markdown content field for rendering.
- **title** `string | null` — The title of the post, displayed prominently at the top. Required for paywalled posts as it remains visible to non-purchasers.
- **visibility** `ForumPostVisibilityTypes | null` — Controls who can see this forum post, such as members only or public.
  - _uno de:_
    - **ForumPostVisibilityTypes**
      - The visibility types for forum posts
    - **null**

### Respuestas

**`200`** — A successful response

- **attachments** `object[]` _requerido_ — All file attachments on this post, such as images, documents, and videos.
  - `array` de:
    - **content_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — Uploaded file MIME type, such as image/jpeg, video/mp4, or audio/mpeg.
    - **filename** `string | null` _requerido_ — The original filename of the uploaded attachment, including its file extension.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Represents a unique identifier that is Base64 obfuscated. It is often used to refetch an object or as key for a cache. The ID type appears in a JSON response as a String; however, it is not intended to be human-readable. When expected as an input type, any string (such as `"VXNlci0xMA=="`) or integer (such as `4`) input value will be accepted as an ID.
    - **url** `string | null` _requerido_ — A pre-optimized URL for rendering this attachment on the client. This should be used for displaying attachments in apps.
- **comment_count** `integer` _requerido_ — The total number of direct comments on this post.
- **content** `string | null` _requerido_ — The body of the forum post in Markdown format. Null if the post is paywalled and the current user does not have access.

## `GET /forums`

## `PATCH /forums/{id}`

**Update forum**

Update moderation and notification settings for a forum, such as who can post, who can comment, and email notification preferences. Required permissions: - `forum:moderate`

`operationId`: `updateForum` · tags: `Forums` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier of the forum to update. Accepts either an experience ID (e.g. 'exp_xxxxx') or a forum ID.

### Request body — `application/json`

- **banned_words** `array | null` — A list of words that are automatically blocked from posts in this forum. For example, ['spam', 'scam'].
  - `array` de:
    - Represents textual data as UTF-8 character sequences. This type is most often used by GraphQL to represent free-form human-readable text.
- **banner_image** `object | null` — The banner image displayed at the top of the forum page. Pass null to remove the existing banner.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The ID of an existing file object.
- **email_notification_preference** `ForumEmailNotificationPreferences | null` — Controls how email notifications are sent to members when new posts are created in this forum.
  - _uno de:_
    - **ForumEmailNotificationPreferences**
      - Email notification preference option for a forum feed
    - **null**
- **who_can_comment** `ForumWhoCanCommentTypes | null` — Controls which roles are allowed to comment on posts in this forum.
  - _uno de:_
    - **ForumWhoCanCommentTypes**
      - Who can comment on a forum feed
    - **null**
- **who_can_post** `ForumWhoCanPostTypes | null` — Controls which roles are allowed to create new posts in this forum.

## `GET /identity_profiles`

**List identity profiles**

Returns a paginated list of identity profiles. When company_id is provided, lists IPs currently linked to that company's ledger. When omitted, lists IPs linked to any ledger the actor can read (including child companies under a parent). Required permissions: - `identity:read`

`operationId`: `listIdentityProfile` · tags: `Identity profiles` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **after** (`query`) `string`
- **before** (`query`) `string`
- **first** (`query`) `integer`
- **last** (`query`) `integer`
- **company_id** (`query`) `string`
- **profile_type** (`query`) `IdentityProfileKinds`
- **status** (`query`) `IdentityProfileStatuses`

### Respuestas

**`200`** — A successful response

- **data** `IdentityProfileListItem[]` _requerido_ — A list of nodes.
  - `array` de:
    - **business_address** `object | null` _requerido_ — Registered business address reported by the identity provider. Present on `business` profiles.
      - **city** `string | null` _requerido_ — The city of the address.
      - **country** `string | null` _requerido_ — The country of the address.
      - **line1** `string | null` _requerido_ — The line 1 of the address.
      - **line2** `string | null` _requerido_ — The line 2 of the address.
      - **postal_code** `string | null` _requerido_ — The postal code of the address.
      - **state** `string | null` _requerido_ — The state of the address.
    - **business_name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Business entity name. Present on `business` profiles.
    - **business_structure** `string | null` _requerido_ — Reported legal structure of a business profile (e.g. `corp`, `llc`). Provider-specific values; present on `business` profiles.
    - **country** `string | null` _requerido_ — ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code reported by the identity provider, such as `US` or `GB`. For individuals this is the country of citizenship or residence; for businesses, the country of incorporation.
    - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the identity profile was first created. · formato: `date-time`
    - **date_of_birth** `string | null` _requerido_ — ISO date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) reported by the identity provider. Present on `individual` profiles.
    - **email** `string | null` _requerido_ — Email address reported by the identity provider. Typically present on `individual` profiles.
    - **first_name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Individual's first name.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The tag of the identity profile (idpf_xxx).
    - **last_name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Individual's last name.
    - **linked_companies** `object[]` _requerido_ — The companies this identity profile is currently linked to. Only populated for direct Whop user sessions; always empty when authenticated via API key, app, or OAuth scope (a single identity can be linked to companies the calling platform is not entitled to see).
      - `array` de:
        - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the company.
        - **title** `string` _requerido_ — The display name of the company shown to customers.
    - **payout_status** `PayoutAccountCalculatedStatuses` _requerido_ — Progress of payout-account setup for this profile, independent of holds. `connected` means onboarding is complete; a `connected` status paired with `payouts_enabled: false` indicates an active account restriction rather than incomplete setup. · valores: `connected`, `disabled`, `action_required`, `pending_verification`, `verification_failed`, `manual_review`, `denied`, `not_started`, `blocked_by_parent`
    - **payouts_enabled** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether this profile can receive payouts right now. True only when payout onboarding is complete and no payout holds are active on the linked account. Treat this as the single source of truth for payout readiness.
    - **personal_address** `object | null` _requerido_ — Residential address reported by the identity provider. Present on `individual` profiles.
      - **city** `string | null` _requerido_ — The city of the address.
      - **country** `string | null` _requerido_ — The country of the address.
      - **line1** `string | null` _requerido_ — The line 1 of the address.
      - **line2** `string | null` _requerido_ — The line 2 of the address.
      - **postal_code** `string | null` _requerido_ — The postal code of the address.
      - **state** `string | null` _requerido_ — The state of the address.
    - **phone** `string | null` _requerido_ — Phone number reported by the identity provider. Typically present on `individual` profiles.
    - **profile_type** `string` _requerido_ — Whether this is an 'individual' or 'business' profile.
    - **status** `IdentityProfileStatuses` _requerido_ — Derived verification status across all linked verifications. Returns `action_required` whenever the profile has an open request for information (whether a verification, payout, or audit RFI) — i.e. the merchant must submit something before it is in good standing. · valores: `not_started`, `pending`, `manual_review`, `approved`, `rejected`, `action_required`
    - **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the identity profile was last synced from a verification. · formato: `date-time`
    - **verifications** `object[]` _requerido_ — All verification attempts attached to this identity profile, ordered most-recent first.
      - `array` de:
        - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the verification record was created. · formato: `date-time`
        - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The numeric id of the verification record.
        - **last_error_code** `VerificationErrorCodes | null` _requerido_ — The most recent error code returned during verification. Null if no error has occurred.
          - _uno de:_
            - **VerificationErrorCodes**
              - An error code for a verification attempt.
            - **null**
        - **last_error_reason** `string | null` _requerido_ — A human-readable explanation of the most recent verification error. Null if no error has occurred.
        - **session_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — A URL the user can visit to complete the verification process. Null if the session does not require user interaction.
        - **status** `VerificationStatuses` _requerido_ — The current status of this verification session. · valores: `requires_input`, `processing`, `verified`, `canceled`, `created`, `started`, `submitted`, `approved`, `declined`, `resubmission_requested`, `expired`, `abandoned`, `review`, `action_required`, `manual_review`
- **page_info** `PageInfo` _requerido_ — Information to aid in pagination.
  - **end_cursor** `string | null` _requerido_ — When paginating forwards, the cursor to continue.
  - **has_next_page** `boolean` _requerido_ — When paginating forwards, are there more items?
  - **has_previous_page** `boolean` _requerido_ — When paginating backwards, are there more items?
  - **start_cursor** `string | null` _requerido_ — When paginating backwards, the cursor to continue.

## `POST /invoices`

**Create invoice**

Create an invoice for a customer. The invoice can be charged automatically using a stored payment method, or sent to the customer for manual payment. Required permissions: - `invoice:create` - `member:email:read` - `member:basic:read` - `payment:basic:read`

`operationId`: `createInvoice` · tags: `Invoices` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- _uno de:_
  - **object**
    - **automatically_finalizes_at** `string | null` — The date and time when the invoice will be automatically finalized. For charge_automatically, triggers an automatic charge. For send_invoice, sends the invoice email to the customer at the specified time. · formato: `date-time`
    - **billing_address** `object | null` — Inline billing address to create a new mailing address for this invoice. Cannot be used together with mailing_address_id.
      - **city** `string | null` — The city of the address.
      - **country** `string | null` — The country of the address.
      - **line1** `string | null` — The line 1 of the address.
      - **line2** `string | null` — The line 2 of the address.
      - **name** `string | null` — The name of the customer.
      - **phone** `string | null` — The phone number of the customer.
      - **postal_code** `string | null` — The postal code of the address.
      - **state** `string | null` — The state of the address.
      - **tax_id_type** `TaxIdentifierTypes | null` — The type of tax identifier.
        - _uno de:_
          - **TaxIdentifierTypes**
            - The type of tax identifier
          - **null**
      - **tax_id_value** `string | null` — The value of the tax identifier.
    - **charge_buyer_fee** `boolean | null` — Whether to charge the customer a buyer fee on this invoice.
    - **collection_method** `InvoiceCollectionMethods` _requerido_ — How the invoice should be collected. Use charge_automatically to charge a stored payment method, or send_invoice to email the customer. · valores: `send_invoice`, `charge_automatically`
    - **company_id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier of the company to create this invoice for.
    - **customer_name** `string | null` — The name of the customer. Required when creating an invoice for a customer who is not yet a member of the company.
    - **due_date** `string | null` — The date by which the invoice must be paid. Required unless save_as_draft is true. · formato: `date-time`
    - **email_address** `string | null` — The email address of the customer. Required when creating an invoice for a customer who is not yet a member of the company.
    - **line_items** `array | null` — Optional line items that break down the invoice total. When provided, the sum of (quantity * unit_price) for all items must equal the plan price. Individual items may be negative to represent a credit, as long as the sum is not negative and clears the currency's minimum charge.
      - `array` de:
        - **label** `string` _requerido_ — The label or description for this line item.
        - **quantity** `number | null` — The quantity of this line item. Defaults to 1.
        - **unit_price** `number` _requerido_ — The unit price for this line item. Provided as a number in the specified currency. Eg: 10.43 for $10.43. Negative values represent a credit or deduction, as long as the line items still total a chargeable amount.
    - **mailing_address_id** `string | null` — The unique identifier of an existing mailing address to attach to this invoice. Cannot be used together with billing_address.
    - **member_id** `string | null` — The unique identifier of an existing member to create this invoice for. If not provided, you must supply an email_address and customer_name.
    - **payment_method_id** `string | null` — The unique identifier of the payment method to charge. Required when collection_method is charge_automatically.
    - **payment_token_id** `string | null` — The payment token ID to use for this invoice. If using charge_automatically, you must provide a payment_token.
    - **plan** `object` _requerido_ — The plan attributes defining the price, currency, and billing interval for this invoice.
      - **adaptive_pricing_enabled** `boolean | null` — Whether this plan accepts local currency payments via adaptive pricing.
      - **billing_period** `integer | null` — The interval in days at which the plan charges (renewal plans).
      - **currency** `Currencies | null` — The three-letter ISO currency code for the plan's pricing. Defaults to USD.

          - **order** `integer | null` — The order of the field.
          - **placeholder** `string | null` — The placeholder value of the field.
          - **required** `boolean | null` — Whether or not the field is required.
      - **description** `string | null` — The description of the plan.
      - **expiration_days** `integer | null` — The number of days until the membership expires and revokes access (expiration plans). For example, 365 for a one-year access period.
      - **initial_price** `number | null` — An additional amount charged upon first purchase. Use only if a one time payment OR you want to charge an additional amount on top of the renewal price. Provided as a number in the specified currency. Eg: 10.43 for $10.43
      - **internal_notes** `string | null` — A personal description or notes section for the business.

## `GET /invoices/{id}`

**Retrieve invoice**

Retrieves the details of an existing invoice. Required permissions: - `invoice:basic:read` - `member:email:read` - `member:basic:read` - `payment:basic:read`

`operationId`: `retrieveInvoice` · tags: `Invoices` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier of the invoice, or a secure token.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — A successful response

- **automatically_finalizes_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — The date and time when the invoice will be automatically finalized. For charge_automatically, triggers an automatic charge. For send_invoice, sends the invoice email at the specified time. · formato: `date-time`
- **charge_buyer_fee** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether the invoice includes a buyer processing fee on top of the plan price.
- **collection_method** `InvoiceCollectionMethods` _requerido_ — The method used to collect payment for this invoice, such as automatic charging or manual payment. · valores: `send_invoice`, `charge_automatically`
- **company** `object` _requerido_ — The company that issued this invoice.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the company.
- **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — The datetime the invoice was created. · formato: `date-time`
- **current_plan** `object` _requerido_ — The plan that this invoice charges for.
  - **currency** `Currencies` _requerido_ — The currency used for all prices on this plan (e.g., 'usd', 'eur'). All monetary amounts on the plan are denominated in this currency. · valores: `usd`, `sgd`, `inr`, `aud`, `brl`, `cad`, `dkk`, `eur`, `nok`, `gbp`, `sek`, `chf`, `hkd`, `huf`, `jpy`, `mxn`, `myr`, `pln`, `czk`, `nzd`, `aed`, `eth`, `ape`, `cop` …
  - **description** `string | null` _requerido_ — A text description of the plan visible to customers. Maximum 1000 characters. Null if no description is set.
  - **formatted_price** `string` _requerido_ — The formatted price (including currency) for the plan.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the plan.
- **customer_name** `string | null` _requerido_ — The full name of the customer this invoice is addressed to. Null if no name is on file.
- **due_date** `string | null` _requerido_ — The deadline by which payment is expected. Null if the invoice is collected automatically. · formato: `date-time`
- **email_address** `string | null` _requerido_ — The email address of the customer this invoice is addressed to. Null if no email is on file.
- **fetch_invoice_token** `string` _requerido_ — A signed token that allows fetching invoice data publicly without authentication.
- **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the invoice.
- **line_items** `object[]` _requerido_ — Optional line items that break down the invoice total into individual charges.
  - `array` de:
    - **label** `string` _requerido_ — The label or description for this line item.
    - **position** `integer` _requerido_ — The display order of this line item within the invoice.
    - **quantity** `number` _requerido_ — The quantity of this line item.
    - **total** `number` _requerido_ — The computed total for this line item (quantity * unit_price).
    - **unit_price** `number` _requerido_ — The unit price for this line item. Negative for a credit or deduction.
- **mailing_address** `object | null` _requerido_ — The billing/mailing address associated with this invoice, if one was provided at creation time.
  - **city** `string | null` _requerido_ — The city of the address.
  - **country** `string | null` _requerido_ — The country of the address.
  - **line1** `string | null` _requerido_ — The line 1 of the address.
  - **line2** `string | null` _requerido_ — The line 2 of the address.
  - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — The name of the customer.
  - **phone** `string | null` _requerido_ — The phone number of the customer.
  - **postal_code** `string | null` _requerido_ — The postal code of the address.
  - **state** `string | null` _requerido_ — The state of the address.
- **member** `object | null` _requerido_ — The member that the invoice was created for. Null when the invoice is addressed to an email address with no member record behind it.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the company member.
- **number** `string` _requerido_ — The sequential invoice number for display purposes.
- **pay_online_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — The checkout URL where the customer can pay this invoice online, with their email address pre-filled and locked.

- **payment_processing** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether a payment on this invoice is still clearing. True while a delayed payment method such as ACH or SEPA settles, during which the invoice stays open and is not marked past due.
- **product** `object` _requerido_ — The product that this invoice was generated for.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the product.
  - **title** `string` _requerido_ — The display name of the product shown to customers on the product page and in search results.

## `PATCH /invoices/{id}`

**Update invoice**

Update a draft invoice's details. Required permissions: - `invoice:update` - `member:email:read` - `member:basic:read` - `payment:basic:read`

`operationId`: `updateInvoice` · tags: `Invoices` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier of the invoice to update.

### Request body — `application/json`

- **automatically_finalizes_at** `string | null` — The date and time when the invoice will be automatically finalized. For charge_automatically, triggers an automatic charge. For send_invoice, sends the invoice email at the specified time. · formato: `date-time`
- **billing_address** `object | null` — Inline billing address to create or update a mailing address for this invoice.
  - **city** `string | null` — The city of the address.
  - **country** `string | null` — The country of the address.
  - **line1** `string | null` — The line 1 of the address.
  - **line2** `string | null` — The line 2 of the address.
  - **name** `string | null` — The name of the customer.
  - **phone** `string | null` — The phone number of the customer.
  - **postal_code** `string | null` — The postal code of the address.
  - **state** `string | null` — The state of the address.
  - **tax_id_type** `TaxIdentifierTypes | null` — The type of tax identifier.
    - _uno de:_
      - **TaxIdentifierTypes**
        - The type of tax identifier
      - **null**
  - **tax_id_value** `string | null` — The value of the tax identifier.
- **charge_buyer_fee** `boolean | null` — Whether to charge the customer a buyer fee on this invoice.
- **collection_method** `InvoiceCollectionMethods | null` — How the invoice should be collected.
  - _uno de:_
    - **InvoiceCollectionMethods**
      - The method of collection for an invoice.
    - **null**
- **customer_name** `string | null` — The name of the customer.
- **due_date** `string | null` — The date by which the invoice must be paid. · formato: `date-time`
- **email_address** `string | null` — The email address of the customer.
- **line_items** `array | null` — Line items that break down the invoice total. When provided, the sum of (quantity * unit_price) for all items must equal the plan price. Individual items may be negative to represent a credit, as long as the sum is not negative and clears the currency's minimum charge. Pass an empty list to remove the breakdown.
  - `array` de:
    - **label** `string` _requerido_ — The label or description for this line item.
    - **quantity** `number | null` — The quantity of this line item. Defaults to 1.
    - **unit_price** `number` _requerido_ — The unit price for this line item. Provided as a number in the specified currency. Eg: 10.43 for $10.43. Negative values represent a credit or deduction, as long as the line items still total a chargeable amount.
- **mailing_address_id** `string | null` — The unique identifier of an existing mailing address to attach.
- **member_id** `string | null` — The unique identifier of a member to assign as the customer.
- **payment_method_id** `string | null` — The unique identifier of the payment method to charge.
- **plan** `object | null` — Updated plan attributes.
  - **adaptive_pricing_enabled** `boolean | null` — Whether this plan accepts local currency payments via adaptive pricing.
  - **billing_period** `integer | null` — The interval in days at which the plan charges (renewal plans).
  - **currency** `Currencies | null` — The three-letter ISO currency code for the plan's pricing. Defaults to USD.
    - _uno de:_
      - **Currencies**
        - The available currencies on the platform
      - **null**
  - **custom_fields** `array | null` — An array of custom field objects.
    - `array` de:
      - **field_type** `CustomFieldTypes` _requerido_ — The type of the custom field.
      - **id** `string | null` — The ID of the custom field (if being updated)
      - **name** `string` _requerido_ — The name of the custom field.
      - **order** `integer | null` — The order of the field.
      - **placeholder** `string | null` — The placeholder value of the field.
      - **required** `boolean | null` — Whether or not the field is required.
  - **description** `string | null` — The description of the plan.
  - **expiration_days** `integer | null` — The number of days until the membership expires and revokes access (expiration plans). For example, 365 for a one-year access period.
  - **initial_price** `number | null` — An additional amount charged upon first purchase. Use only if a one time payment OR you want to charge an additional amount on top of the renewal price. Provided as a number in the specified currency. Eg: 10.43 for $10.43
  - **internal_notes** `string | null` — A personal description or notes section for the business.
  - **legacy_payment_method_controls** `boolean | null` — Whether this plan uses legacy payment method controls
  - **payment_method_configuration** `object | null` — The explicit payment method configuration for the plan. If not provided, the platform or company's defaults will apply.
    - **disabled** `PaymentMethodTypes[]` _requerido_ — An array of payment method identifiers that are explicitly disabled. Only applies if the include_platform_defaults is true.
      - `array` de:
        - The different types of payment methods that can be used.
    - **enabled** `PaymentMethodTypes[]` _requerido_ — An array of payment method identifiers that are explicitly enabled. This means these payment methods will be shown on checkout. Example use case is to only enable a specific payment method like cashapp, or extending the platform defaults with additional methods.
      - `array` de:
        - The different types of payment methods that can be used.
    - **include_platform_defaults** `boolean | null` — Whether Whop's platform default payment method enablement settings are included in this configuration. The full list of default payment methods can be found in the documentation at docs.whop.com/payments.
  - **plan_type** `PlanTypes | null` — Indicates if the plan is a one time payment or recurring.
    - _uno de:_
      - **PlanTypes**
        - The type of plan that can be attached to a product
      - **null**
  - **release_method** `ReleaseMethod | null` — This is the release method the business uses to sell this plan.
    - _uno de:_
      - **ReleaseMethod**
        - The methods of how a plan can be released.
      - **null**
  - **renewal_price** `number | null` — The amount the customer is charged every billing period. Use only if a recurring payment. Provided as a number in the specified currency. Eg: 10.43 for $10.43
  - **stock** `integer | null` — The number of units available for purchase.
  - **trial_period_days** `integer | null` — The number of free trial days added before a renewal plan.
  - **unlimited_stock** `boolean | null` — When true, the plan has unlimited stock (stock field is ignored). When false, purchases are limited by the stock field.
  - **visibility** `Visibility | null` — Shows or hides the plan from public/business view.
    - _uno de:_
      - **Visibility**
        - Visibility of a resource
      - **null**
- **product_id** `string | null` — The unique identifier of an existing product to attach to this invoice. Only allowed while the invoice is still a draft.
- **subscription_billing_anchor_at** `string | null` — The date that defines when the subscription billing cycle should start. · formato: `date-time`

### Respuestas

**`200`** — A successful response

- **automatically_finalizes_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — The date and time when the invoice will be automatically finalized. For charge_automatically, triggers an automatic charge. For send_invoice, sends the invoice email at the specified time. · formato: `date-time`
- **charge_buyer_fee** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether the invoice includes a buyer processing fee on top of the plan price.
- **collection_method** `InvoiceCollectionMethods` _requerido_ — The method used to collect payment for this invoice, such as automatic charging or manual payment. · valores: `send_invoice`, `charge_automatically`
- **company** `object` _requerido_ — The company that issued this invoice.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the company.
- **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — The datetime the invoice was created. · formato: `date-time`
- **current_plan** `object` _requerido_ — The plan that this invoice charges for.
  - **currency** `Currencies` _requerido_ — The currency used for all prices on this plan (e.g., 'usd', 'eur'). All monetary amounts on the plan are denominated in this currency. · valores: `usd`, `sgd`, `inr`, `aud`, `brl`, `cad`, `dkk`, `eur`, `nok`, `gbp`, `sek`, `chf`, `hkd`, `huf`, `jpy`, `mxn`, `myr`, `pln`, `czk`, `nzd`, `aed`, `eth`, `ape`, `cop` …
  - **description** `string | null` _requerido_ — A text description of the plan visible to customers. Maximum 1000 characters. Null if no description is set.
  - **formatted_price** `string` _requerido_ — The formatted price (including currency) for the plan.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the plan.
- **customer_name** `string | null` _requerido_ — The full name of the customer this invoice is addressed to. Null if no name is on file.
- **due_date** `string | null` _requerido_ — The deadline by which payment is expected. Null if the invoice is collected automatically. · formato: `date-time`
- **email_address** `string | null` _requerido_ — The email address of the customer this invoice is addressed to. Null if no email is on file.
- **fetch_invoice_token** `string` _requerido_ — A signed token that allows fetching invoice data publicly without authentication.
- **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the invoice.
- **line_items** `object[]` _requerido_ — Optional line items that break down the invoice total into individual charges.
  - `array` de:
    - **label** `string` _requerido_ — The label or description for this line item.
    - **position** `integer` _requerido_ — The display order of this line item within the invoice.
    - **quantity** `number` _requerido_ — The quantity of this line item.
    - **total** `number` _requerido_ — The computed total for this line item (quantity * unit_price).
    - **unit_price** `number` _requerido_ — The unit price for this line item. Negative for a credit or deduction.
- **mailing_address** `object | null` _requerido_ — The billing/mailing address associated with this invoice, if one was provided at creation time.
  - **city** `string | null` _requerido_ — The city of the address.
  - **country** `string | null` _requerido_ — The country of the address.
  - **line1** `string | null` _requerido_ — The line 1 of the address.
  - **line2** `string | null` _requerido_ — The line 2 of the address.
  - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — The name of the customer.
  - **phone** `string | null` _requerido_ — The phone number of the customer.
  - **postal_code** `string | null` _requerido_ — The postal code of the address.
  - **state** `string | null` _requerido_ — The state of the address.
- **member** `object | null` _requerido_ — The member that the invoice was created for. Null when the invoice is addressed to an email address with no member record behind it.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the company member.
- **number** `string` _requerido_ — The sequential invoice number for display purposes.
- **pay_online_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — The checkout URL where the customer can pay this invoice online, with their email address pre-filled and locked.
- **payment** `object | null` _requerido_ — The payment that settled this invoice. Null while the invoice is unpaid, when the invoice was marked paid manually, and on a subscription renewal invoice, where the settling payment cannot yet be identified.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the payment.
- **payment_processing** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether a payment on this invoice is still clearing. True while a delayed payment method such as ACH or SEPA settles, during which the invoice stays open and is not marked past due.
- **product** `object` _requerido_ — The product that this invoice was generated for.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the product.
  - **title** `string` _requerido_ — The display name of the product shown to customers on the product page and in search results.
- **status** `InvoiceStatuses` _requerido_ — The current payment status of the invoice, such as draft, open, paid, or void. · valores: `draft`, `open`, `paid`, `past_due`, `uncollectible`, `void`
- **subscription_billing_anchor_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — The date that defines when the subscription billing cycle starts. When set on a renewal plan invoice, all future billing periods anchor to this date. · formato: `date-time`
- **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — The datetime the invoice was last updated. · formato: `date-time`
- **user** `object | null` _requerido_ — The user this invoice is addressed to. Null if the user account has been removed.
  - **email** `string | null` _requerido_ — The user's email address. Requires the member:email:read permission to access. Null if not authorized.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the user.
  - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — The user's display name shown on their public profile.
  - **username** `string` _requerido_ — The user's unique username shown on their public profile.

## `GET /leads`

**List leads**

Returns a paginated list of leads for a company, with optional filtering by product and creation date. Required permissions: - `lead:basic:read` - `member:email:read` - `access_pass:basic:read` - `member:basic:read`

`operationId`: `listLead` · tags: `Leads` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **after** (`query`) `string`
- **before** (`query`) `string`
- **first** (`query`) `integer`
- **last** (`query`) `integer`
- **company_id** (`query`) `string` _requerido_
- **created_after** (`query`) `string`
- **created_before** (`query`) `string`
- **product_ids** (`query`) `string[]`

### Respuestas

**`200`** — A successful response

- **data** `LeadListItem[]` _requerido_ — A list of nodes.
  - `array` de:
    - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — The datetime the lead was created. · formato: `date-time`

## `GET /ledger_accounts/{id}`

**Retrieve ledger account**

Retrieves the details of an existing ledger account. Required permissions: - `company:balance:read` - `payout:account:read`

`operationId`: `retrieveLedgerAccount` · tags: `Ledger accounts` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — The identifier to look up the ledger account. Accepts a user ID ('user_xxx'), company ID ('biz_xxx'), or ledger account ID ('ldgr_xxx').

### Respuestas

**`200`** — A successful response

- **balances** `object[]` _requerido_ — The balances associated with the account.
  - `array` de:
    - **balance** `number` _requerido_ — The amount of the balance.
    - **currency** `Currencies` _requerido_ — The currency of the balance. · valores: `usd`, `sgd`, `inr`, `aud`, `brl`, `cad`, `dkk`, `eur`, `nok`, `gbp`, `sek`, `chf`, `hkd`, `huf`, `jpy`, `mxn`, `myr`, `pln`, `czk`, `nzd`, `aed`, `eth`, `ape`, `cop` …
    - **pending_balance** `number` _requerido_ — The amount of the balance that is pending.
    - **reserve_balance** `number` _requerido_ — The amount of the balance that is reserved.
- **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the ledger account.
- **ledger_type** `LedgerTypes` _requerido_ — The type of ledger account. · valores: `primary`, `pool`
- **owner** `object | null | object | null` _requerido_ — The owner of the ledger account.
  - _uno de:_
    - **object | null**
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the user.
      - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — The user's display name shown on their public profile.
      - **typename** `string` _requerido_ — The typename of this object
      - **username** `string` _requerido_ — The user's unique username shown on their public profile.
    - **object | null**
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the company.
      - **route** `string` _requerido_ — URL slug for the account's store page, e.g. `pickaxe` in whop.com/pickaxe.
      - **title** `string` _requerido_ — The display name of the company shown to customers.
      - **typename** `string` _requerido_ — The typename of this object
- **payments_approval_status** `PaymentsApprovalStatuses | null` _requerido_ — The status of payments approval for the ledger account.
  - _uno de:_
    - **PaymentsApprovalStatuses**
      - The different approval statuses an account can have.
    - **null**
- **payout_account_details** `object | null` _requerido_ — The payout account associated with the LedgerAccount, if any.
  - **address** `object | null` _requerido_ — The physical address associated with this payout account
    - **city** `string | null` _requerido_ — The city of the address.
    - **country** `string | null` _requerido_ — The country of the address.
    - **line1** `string | null` _requerido_ — The line 1 of the address.
    - **line2** `string | null` _requerido_ — The line 2 of the address.
    - **postal_code** `string | null` _requerido_ — The postal code of the address.

- **promo_code_ids** (`query`) `string[]`

## `GET /memberships`

**List memberships**

Returns a paginated list of memberships, with optional filtering by product, plan, status, and user. Required permissions: - `member:basic:read` - `member:email:read`

`operationId`: `listMembership` · tags: `Memberships` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **after** (`query`) `string`
- **before** (`query`) `string`
- **first** (`query`) `integer`
- **last** (`query`) `integer`
- **company_id** (`query`) `string`
- **direction** (`query`) `Direction`
- **order** (`query`) `MembershipsSortableColumns`
- **product_ids** (`query`) `string[]`
- **statuses** (`query`) `MembershipStatus[]`
- **cancel_options** (`query`) `CancelOptions[]`
- **cancelation_status** (`query`) `CancelationStatus`
- **has_cancelation_reason** (`query`) `boolean`
- **include_text_only_cancelation_reasons** (`query`) `boolean`
- **plan_ids** (`query`) `string[]`
- **user_ids** (`query`) `string[]`
- **promo_code_ids** (`query`) `string[]`
- **created_before** (`query`) `string`
- **created_after** (`query`) `string`

### Respuestas

**`200`** — A successful response

- **data** `MembershipListItem[]` _requerido_ — A list of nodes.
  - `array` de:
    - **cancel_at_period_end** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether this membership is set to cancel at the end of the current billing cycle. Only applies to memberships with a recurring plan.
    - **cancel_option** `CancelOptions | null` _requerido_ — The category selected for why the member canceled (e.g. too_expensive, switching, missing_features).
      - _uno de:_
        - **CancelOptions**
          - The different reasons a user can choose for why they are canceling their membership.
        - **null**
    - **cancelation_status** `CancelationStatus | null` _requerido_ — Whether the customer is canceling, left, or was won back. Null if the membership has no cancellation reason or its cancellation state is indeterminate.
      - _uno de:_
        - **CancelationStatus**
          - The state of a membership after a customer provides a cancelation reason.
        - **null**
    - **canceled_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — The time the customer initiated cancellation of this membership. As a Unix timestamp. Null if the membership has not been canceled. · formato: `date-time`
    - **cancellation_reason** `string | null` _requerido_ — Free-text explanation provided by the customer when canceling. Null if the customer did not provide a reason.
    - **checkout_configuration_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — The ID of the checkout session/configuration that produced this membership, if any. Use this to map memberships back to the checkout configuration that created them.
    - **company** `object` _requerido_ — The company this membership belongs to.
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the company.
      - **title** `string` _requerido_ — The display name of the company shown to customers.
    - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — The datetime the membership was created. · formato: `date-time`
    - **currency** `Currencies | null` _requerido_ — The three-letter ISO currency code for this membership's billing. Null if the membership is free.
      - _uno de:_
        - **Currencies**
          - The available currencies on the platform
        - **null**
    - **formatted_renewal_price** `string | null` _requerido_ — The recurring renewal price for this membership, formatted with currency symbol and billing interval. Null if the membership is not recurring.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the membership.
    - **initial_price_paid** `string` _requerido_ — The amount the customer paid when first purchasing this membership, formatted with currency symbol.
    - **joined_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — The time the user first joined the company associated with this membership. As a Unix timestamp. Null if the member record does not exist. · formato: `date-time`
    - **license_key** `string | null` _requerido_ — The software license key associated with this membership. Only present if the product includes a Whop Software Licensing experience. Null otherwise.
    - **manage_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — The URL where the customer can view and manage this membership, including cancellation and plan changes. Null if no member record exists.
    - **member** `object | null` _requerido_ — The member record linking the user to the company for this membership. Null if the member record has not been created yet.
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the member.
    - **metadata** `object | null` _requerido_ — Custom key-value pairs for the membership (commonly used for software licensing, e.g., HWID). Max 50 keys, 100 chars per key, 500 chars per string value.
    - **payment_collection_paused** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether recurring payment collection for this membership is temporarily paused by the company.
    - **plan** `object` _requerido_ — The plan the customer purchased to create this membership.
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the plan.
      - **metadata** `object | null` _requerido_ — Custom key-value pairs stored on the plan. Included in webhook payloads for payment and membership events. Max 50 keys, 100 chars per key, 500 chars per string value. The reserved keys `custom_cta` and `custom_cta_url`, when set, override the product's checkout call to action for this plan.
    - **product** `object` _requerido_ — The product this membership grants access to.
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the product.
      - **metadata** `object | null` _requerido_ — Custom key-value pairs stored on the product and included in payment and membership webhook payloads. Max 50 keys, 100 characters per key, 500 characters per string value.
      - **title** `string` _requerido_ — The display name of the product shown to customers on the product page and in search results.
    - **promo_code** `object | null` _requerido_ — The promotional code currently applied to this membership's billing. Null if no promo code is active.

## `GET /memberships/{id}`

**Retrieve membership**

Retrieves the details of an existing membership. Required permissions: - `member:basic:read` - `member:email:read`

`operationId`: `retrieveMembership` · tags: `Memberships` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier of the membership, or a license key.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — A successful response

- **cancel_at_period_end** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether this membership is set to cancel at the end of the current billing cycle. Only applies to memberships with a recurring plan.
- **cancel_option** `CancelOptions | null` _requerido_ — The category selected for why the member canceled (e.g. too_expensive, switching, missing_features).
  - _uno de:_
    - **CancelOptions**
      - The different reasons a user can choose for why they are canceling their membership.
    - **null**
- **cancelation_status** `CancelationStatus | null` _requerido_ — Whether the customer is canceling, left, or was won back. Null if the membership has no cancellation reason or its cancellation state is indeterminate.
  - _uno de:_
    - **CancelationStatus**
      - The state of a membership after a customer provides a cancelation reason.
    - **null**
- **canceled_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — The time the customer initiated cancellation of this membership. As a Unix timestamp. Null if the membership has not been canceled. · formato: `date-time`
- **cancellation_reason** `string | null` _requerido_ — Free-text explanation provided by the customer when canceling. Null if the customer did not provide a reason.
- **checkout_configuration_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — The ID of the checkout session/configuration that produced this membership, if any. Use this to map memberships back to the checkout configuration that created them.

  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the company.
  - **title** `string` _requerido_ — The display name of the company shown to customers.
- **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — The datetime the membership was created. · formato: `date-time`
- **currency** `Currencies | null` _requerido_ — The three-letter ISO currency code for this membership's billing. Null if the membership is free.
  - _uno de:_

## `POST /memberships/{id}/add_free_days`

**Add free days membership**

Add free days to extend a membership's current billing period, expiration date, or Stripe trial. Required permissions: - `member:manage` - `member:email:read` - `member:basic:read`

`operationId`: `addFreeDaysMembership` · tags: `Memberships` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

## `POST /memberships/{id}/resume`

**Resume membership**

Resume a previously paused membership's recurring payments. Billing resumes on the next cycle. Required permissions: - `member:manage` - `member:email:read` - `member:basic:read`

`operationId`: `resumeMembership` · tags: `Memberships` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier of the membership to resume.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — A successful response

- **cancel_at_period_end** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether this membership is set to cancel at the end of the current billing cycle. Only applies to memberships with a recurring plan.
- **cancel_option** `CancelOptions | null` _requerido_ — The category selected for why the member canceled (e.g. too_expensive, switching, missing_features).
  - _uno de:_
    - **CancelOptions**
      - The different reasons a user can choose for why they are canceling their membership.
    - **null**
- **cancelation_status** `CancelationStatus | null` _requerido_ — Whether the customer is canceling, left, or was won back. Null if the membership has no cancellation reason or its cancellation state is indeterminate.
  - _uno de:_
    - **CancelationStatus**
      - The state of a membership after a customer provides a cancelation reason.
    - **null**
- **canceled_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — The time the customer initiated cancellation of this membership. As a Unix timestamp. Null if the membership has not been canceled. · formato: `date-time`
- **cancellation_reason** `string | null` _requerido_ — Free-text explanation provided by the customer when canceling. Null if the customer did not provide a reason.
- **checkout_configuration_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — The ID of the checkout session/configuration that produced this membership, if any. Use this to map memberships back to the checkout configuration that created them.
- **company** `object` _requerido_ — The company this membership belongs to.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the company.
  - **title** `string` _requerido_ — The display name of the company shown to customers.
- **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — The datetime the membership was created. · formato: `date-time`
- **currency** `Currencies | null` _requerido_ — The three-letter ISO currency code for this membership's billing. Null if the membership is free.
  - _uno de:_
    - **Currencies**
      - The available currencies on the platform
    - **null**
- **custom_field_responses** `object[]` _requerido_ — The customer's responses to custom checkout questions configured on the product at the time of purchase.
  - `array` de:
    - **answer** `string` _requerido_ — The response a user gave to the specific question or field.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the custom field response.
    - **question** `string` _requerido_ — The question asked by the custom field
- **formatted_renewal_price** `string | null` _requerido_ — The recurring renewal price for this membership, formatted with currency symbol and billing interval. Null if the membership is not recurring.
- **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the membership.
- **initial_price_paid** `string` _requerido_ — The amount the customer paid when first purchasing this membership, formatted with currency symbol.

- **license_key** `string | null` _requerido_ — The software license key associated with this membership. Only present if the product includes a Whop Software Licensing experience. Null otherwise.
- **manage_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — The URL where the customer can view and manage this membership, including cancellation and plan changes. Null if no member record exists.
- **member** `object | null` _requerido_ — The member record linking the user to the company for this membership. Null if the member record has not been created yet.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the member.
- **metadata** `object | null` _requerido_ — Custom key-value pairs for the membership (commonly used for software licensing, e.g., HWID). Max 50 keys, 100 chars per key, 500 chars per string value.
- **payment_collection_paused** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether recurring payment collection for this membership is temporarily paused by the company.
- **plan** `object` _requerido_ — The plan the customer purchased to create this membership.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the plan.
  - **metadata** `object | null` _requerido_ — Custom key-value pairs stored on the plan. Included in webhook payloads for payment and membership events. Max 50 keys, 100 chars per key, 500 chars per string value. The reserved keys `custom_cta` and `custom_cta_url`, when set, override the product's checkout call to action for this plan.
- **product** `object` _requerido_ — The product this membership grants access to.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the product.
  - **metadata** `object | null` _requerido_ — Custom key-value pairs stored on the product and included in payment and membership webhook payloads. Max 50 keys, 100 characters per key, 500 characters per string value.
  - **title** `string` _requerido_ — The display name of the product shown to customers on the product page and in search results.
- **promo_code** `object | null` _requerido_ — The promotional code currently applied to this membership's billing. Null if no promo code is active.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the promo code.
- **renewal_period_end** `string | null` _requerido_ — The end of the current billing period for this recurring membership. As a Unix timestamp. Null if the membership is not recurring. · formato: `date-time`
- **renewal_period_start** `string | null` _requerido_ — The start of the current billing period for this recurring membership. As a Unix timestamp. Null if the membership is not recurring. · formato: `date-time`

- **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — The datetime the membership was last updated. · formato: `date-time`

## `POST /memberships/{id}/resync_access`

**Resync access membership**

Re-run access fulfillment for a membership. Recomputes the member's content access on Whop, re-validates their Discord link (re-adding them to the server and re-assigning roles if needed), and re-fulfills TradingView indicator access. Telegram access is invite-based and cannot be resynced here. The outcome is written to the membership's logs.     - **Currencies**

    - **null**

- **payment_collection_paused** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether recurring payment collection for this membership is temporarily paused by the company.
- **plan** `object` _requerido_ — The plan the customer purchased to create this membership.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the plan.
  - **metadata** `object | null` _requerido_ — Custom key-value pairs stored on the plan. Included in webhook payloads for payment and membership events. Max 50 keys, 100 chars per key, 500 chars per string value. The reserved keys `custom_cta` and `custom_cta_url`, when set, override the product's checkout call to action for this plan.
- **product** `object` _requerido_ — The product this membership grants access to.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the product.
  - **metadata** `object | null` _requerido_ — Custom key-value pairs stored on the product and included in payment and membership webhook payloads. Max 50 keys, 100 characters per key, 500 characters per string value.
  - **title** `string` _requerido_ — The display name of the product shown to customers on the product page and in search results.
- **promo_code** `object | null` _requerido_ — The promotional code currently applied to this membership's billing. Null if no promo code is active.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the promo code.

- **renewal_period_start** `string | null` _requerido_ — The start of the current billing period for this recurring membership. As a Unix timestamp. Null if the membership is not recurring. · formato: `date-time`

- **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — The datetime the membership was last updated. · formato: `date-time`

## `GET /messages`

**List messages**

Returns a paginated list of messages within a specific experience chat, DM, or group chat channel, sorted by creation time. Required permissions (one of): - `chat:read` - `dms:read` - `support_chat:read`

`operationId`: `listMessage` · tags: `Messages` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **after** (`query`) `string`
- **before** (`query`) `string`
- **first** (`query`) `integer`
- **last** (`query`) `integer`
- **channel_id** (`query`) `string` _requerido_
- **direction** (`query`) `Direction`

### Respuestas

**`200`** — A successful response

- **data** `MessageListItem[]` _requerido_ — A list of nodes.
  - `array` de:
    - **content** `string | null` _requerido_ — The message content formatted as Markdown. Null if the message has no text content.
    - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — The timestamp when this message was originally created. · formato: `date-time`
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Represents a unique identifier that is Base64 obfuscated. It is often used to refetch an object or as key for a cache. The ID type appears in a JSON response as a String; however, it is not intended to be human-readable. When expected as an input type, any string (such as `"VXNlci0xMA=="`) or integer (such as `4`) input value will be accepted as an ID.
    - **is_edited** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether the message content has been edited after it was originally sent.
    - **is_pinned** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether this message is pinned to the top of the channel for easy access.
    - **mentions** `string[]` _requerido_ — A list of user IDs that are explicitly mentioned in this message.
      - `array` de:
        - Represents a unique identifier that is Base64 obfuscated. It is often used to refetch an object or as key for a cache. The ID type appears in a JSON response as a String; however, it is not intended to be human-readable. When expected as an input type, any string (such as `"VXNlci0xMA=="`) or integer (such as `4`) input value will be accepted as an ID.
    - **mentions_everyone** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether the message includes an @everyone mention that notifies all channel members.
    - **message_type** `DmsPostTypes` _requerido_ — The classification of this message: regular, system, or automated. · valores: `regular`, `system`, `automated`
    - **poll** `object | null` _requerido_ — A poll attached to this message. Null if the message does not contain a poll.
      - **options** `array | null` _requerido_ — The options for the poll
        - `array` de:
          - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier for the poll option.
          - **text** `string` _requerido_ — The text of the poll option
    - **poll_votes** `object[]` _requerido_ — Aggregated reaction counts on this message, filtered to a specific reaction type.
      - `array` de:
        - **count** `integer` _requerido_ — The number of users who reacted

    - **reaction_counts** `object[]` _requerido_ — Aggregated reaction counts on this message, filtered to a specific reaction type.

## `POST /messages`

**Create message**

Send a new message in an experience chat, DM, or group chat channel. Supports text content, attachments, polls, and replies. Required permissions (one of): - `chat:message:create` - `dms:message:manage` - `livestream:chat:write` - `support_chat:message:create`

`operationId`: `createMessage` · tags: `Messages` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- **attachments** `array | null` — A list of file attachments to include with the message, such as images or videos.
  - `array` de:
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The ID of an existing file object.
- **auto_detect_links** `boolean | null` — Automatically detect URLs in the message and generate link previews.
- **channel_id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier of the channel or experience to send the message in. For example, 'exp_xxxxx' or 'feed_xxxxx'.
- **content** `string` _requerido_ — The body of the message in Markdown format. For example, 'Hello **world**'.
- **poll** `object | null` — A poll to attach to this message, allowing recipients to vote on options.
  - **options** `object[]` _requerido_ — The options for the poll. Must have sequential IDs starting from 1
    - `array` de:
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Sequential ID for the poll option (starting from '1')
      - **text** `string` _requerido_ — The text of the poll option
- **replying_to_message_id** `string | null` — The unique identifier of the message this is replying to, creating a threaded reply.

## `DELETE /messages/{id}`

**Delete message**

Permanently delete a message from an experience chat, DM, or group chat channel. Only the message author or a channel admin can delete a message. Required permissions (one of): - `chat:message:create` and `chat:read` - `dms:message:manage` and `dms:read` - `livestream:chat:write` and `livestream:chat:read` - `support_chat:message:create` and `support_chat:read`

`operationId`: `deleteMessage` · tags: `Messages` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier of the message to delete.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — A successful response

- Represents `true` or `false` values.

**`400`** — Bad request

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string | null` — A short string indicating the specific error code, e.g. 'parameter_missing', 'parameter_invalid', 'invalid_json'

## `POST /notifications`

**Create notification**

Send a push notification to users in an experience or company team. The notification is processed asynchronously and supports targeting specific users. Required permissions: - `notification:create`

`operationId`: `createNotification` · tags: `Notifications` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- _uno de:_
  - **object**
    - **company_id** `string` _requerido_ — The unique identifier of the company to target. Only team members of this company will receive the notification. Clicking the notification opens your dashboard app view.
    - **content** `string` _requerido_ — The main body text of the notification displayed to the user.
    - **icon_user_id** `string | null` — The unique identifier of a user whose profile picture will be used as the notification icon. Defaults to the experience or company avatar when not provided.
    - **rest_path** `string | null` — A path segment appended to the generated deep link that opens your app. Use [restPath] in your app path configuration to read this parameter. For example, '/settings/billing'.
    - **subtitle** `string | null` — An optional secondary line of text displayed below the title in the notification.
    - **title** `string` _requerido_ — The headline text of the notification, displayed prominently to the user.
    - **user_ids** `array | null` — An optional list of user IDs to narrow the audience. When provided, only these users receive the notification, provided they are in the targeted experience or company.
